verses.saheeh: The Inevitable Reality -
verses.khattab: The Inevitable Hour
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Reality, the Resurrection in which is realised [the truth of] all that was rejected in the way of the raising [from the graves], the reckoning and the requital, or [it means the Resurrection] which will manifest all of that.
verses.romanUrdu: Honi shudhni ! (indubitable) [sach-much honay wali]

verses.saheeh: What is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.khattab: What is the Inevitable Hour
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What is the Reality? (ma’l-hāqqa: [an interrogative] to emphasise its enormity; this is the subject as well as the predicate of [the previous] al-hāqqa, ‘the Reality’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya hai woh honi shudni (indubitable)

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And how would you know what the Reality is? ([repeated as] an extra emphasis of its enormity; the first mā [of the previous verse] is the subject, the second one, its predicate; the second mā and its predicate also function as the second direct object of [the verb] ‘knowing’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tum kya jaano ke woh kya hai honi shudhni (indubitable)

verses.saheeh: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
verses.khattab: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Clatterer, the Resurrection, because its terrors cause the hearts to clatter.
verses.romanUrdu: Samood aur Aad ne us achanak toot padne wali aafat ko jhutlaya

verses.saheeh: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
verses.khattab: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the [overwhelming] Roar, an excessively severe cry.
verses.romanUrdu: To Samood ek sakht haadse mein halaaq kiye gaye

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحٖ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٖ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاُهْلِكُوْا بِرِيْحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
verses.khattab: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a deafening, intensely clamorous, violent wind, [that was] powerful and severe [in its assault] upon ‘Ād, despite their power and might.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Aad ek badi shadeed toofani aandhi(storm) se tabah kardiye gaye

verses.uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٖ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومٗا ۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٖ
verses.indopak: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَّثَمٰنِيَةَ اَيَّامٍ ۙ حُسُوْمًا ۙ فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيْهَا صَرْعٰى ۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: sakhkharaha 'alayhim sab'a layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sar'a kaannahum a'jazu nakhlin khawiyatun
verses.saheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.khattab: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He forced it upon them for seven nights and eight days, the first of which was the morning of Wednesday, eight days before the end of [the month of] Shawwāl, and this was at the height of winter, successively, one after the next (husūman: it [the action of the wind] is likened to the repeated actions of a hāsim, ‘one cauterizing a wound’, time and again until it [the blood] has been cut off, inhsama) so that you might have seen the people therein lying prostrate, lying dead on the ground, as if they were the hollow, collapsed, trunks of palm-trees.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah taala ne usko musalsal saat (seven) raat aur aath (eight) din unpar musallat rakkha (tum wahan hotey to) dekhte ke woh wahan is tarah pachade paday jaise woh khajoor ke boseeda (rotten) taney (trunks) hon

verses.saheeh: Then do you see of them any remains?
verses.khattab: Do you see any of them left alive
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So do you see any remnant of them? (min bāqiyatin: this is either the adjectival qualification of an implicit nafs, ‘soul’, or the [final suffixed] tā’ is for hyperbole, in other words [understand it as fa-hal tarā lahum] min bāqin, ‘any one remaining?’ No!).
verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya unmein se koi tumhein baki nazar aata hai

verses.uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
verses.indopak: وَجَاۤءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهٗ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكٰتُ بِالْخَـاطِئَةِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wajaa fir'awnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati
verses.saheeh: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.khattab: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Pharaoh and those of his followers (man qibalahu: a variant reading has man qablahu, that is to say, those disbelieving communities who came before him) and the Deviant [cities], that is, their inhabitants — these being the cities of the people of Lot — brought iniquity, [they committed] deeds that were iniquitous.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur isi khata-e-azeem ka irtiqaab Firoun aur ussey pehle ke logon ne aur talpat (overturned) ho janey wali bastiyon ne kiya

verses.uthmani: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً
verses.indopak: فَعَصَوْا رَسُوْلَ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَهُمْ اَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.transliteration: fa'asaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan
verses.saheeh: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
verses.khattab: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, namely, Lot and others, so He seized them with a devastating blow, one surpassing others in its severity.
verses.romanUrdu: Un sab ne apne Rubb ke Rasool ki baat na maani to usne unko bade sakhti ke saath pakda

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الْمَاۤءُ حَمَلْنٰكُمْ فِى الْجَارِيَةِ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
verses.khattab: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly when the waters rose high, [when] they rose above all things including mountains and otherwise at the time of the Flood, We carried you, meaning, your forefathers, you being in their loins, in the sailing vessel, the ark which Noah built and by which he and those with him were saved while all the others drowned,
verses.romanUrdu: Jab pani ka toofan hadd se guzar gaya to humne tumko kashti mein sawar kardiya tha

verses.uthmani: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ
verses.indopak: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَـكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَّتَعِيَهَاۤ اُذُنٌ وَّاعِيَةٌ
verses.transliteration: linaj'alaha lakum tathkiratan wata'iyaha othunun wa'iyatun
verses.saheeh: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
verses.khattab: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that We might make it, namely, this act, the saving of the believers and the destruction of the disbelievers, a reminder, a lesson, for you and that receptive ears, [ears] which remember what they hear, might remember it.
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke is waqiye ko tumhare liye ek sabaq-aamoz yaadgaar bana dein aur yaad rakhne waley kaan iski yaad mehfooz rakkhein

wbw.translation: and would be conscious of it

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ نَفْخَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun
verses.saheeh: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
verses.khattab: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast, to [announce] the passing of judgement upon all creatures — this being the second [blast] —
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab ek dafa sur mein phoonk maar di jayegi

verses.uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ
verses.indopak: وَحُمِلَتِ الْاَرْضُ وَ الْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَّاحِدَةً ۙ
verses.transliteration: wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan
verses.saheeh: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
verses.khattab: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zameen aur pahadon ko utha kar ek hi chot mein reza reza kardiya jayega

verses.saheeh: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
verses.khattab: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then, on that day, the [imminent] Event will come to pass, the Resurrection will take place,
verses.romanUrdu: Us roz woh honay wala waqiya pesh aa jayega

verses.saheeh: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
verses.khattab: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the heaven will be rent asunder — for it will be very frail on that day —
verses.romanUrdu: Usdin Aasmaan phatega aur uski bandish dhili padh jayegi

verses.uthmani: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ ثَمَٰنِيَةٞ
verses.indopak: وَّالْمَلَكُ عَلٰۤى اَرْجَاۤٮِٕهَا ۗ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَٮِٕذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waalmalaku 'ala arjaiha wayahmilu 'arsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun
verses.saheeh: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
verses.khattab: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the angels will be [all] over its borders, the edges of the heavens, and above them — the angels that have been mentioned — on that day eight, angels or [eight] files of them, will carry the Throne of your Lord.
verses.romanUrdu: Farishtey uske atraf-o-jawanib mein hongey aur aat (eight) farishtey us roz tere Rubb ka arsh apne upar uthaye huey hongey

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةٞ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَٮِٕذٍ تُعْرَضُوْنَ لَا تَخْفٰى مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.transliteration: yawmaithin tu'radoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun
verses.saheeh: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
verses.khattab: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden
verses.jalalayn: ﻿On that day you will be exposed, before the Reckoning. No hidden thing of yours, in the way of secrets, will remain hidden (read [feminine person] takhfā or [masculine person] yakhfā).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh din hoga jab tumlog pesh kiye jaogey, tumhara koi raaz bhi chupa na reh jayega

verses.uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
verses.indopak: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِىَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ ۙ فَيَقُوْلُ هَاۤؤُمُ اقْرَءُوْا كِتٰبِيَهْ ۚ
verses.transliteration: faamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu h<u>a</u>omu iqraoo kit<u>a</u>biyah
verses.saheeh: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
verses.khattab: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, addressing those around him, on account of the joy that has come to him: ‘Here, take [and], read my book! (kitābiyah: both hā’ūmu, ‘here [is]’, and iqra’ū, ‘read’, compete for [government of] this [direct object]).
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt jiska naam-e-aamal uske seedhey haath mein diya jayega woh kahega “lo dekho, padho mera naam-e-aamal

verses.saheeh: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
verses.khattab: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I was truly certain that I would encounter my account’.
verses.romanUrdu: Main samajhta tha ke mujhey zaroor apna hisaab milne wala hai”

verses.saheeh: So he will be in a pleasant life -
verses.khattab: They will be in a life of bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So he will enjoy a pleasant living,
verses.romanUrdu: Pas woh dil pasand aish mein hoga

verses.saheeh: In an elevated garden,
verses.khattab: in an elevated Garden
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in a lofty Garden,
verses.romanUrdu: Aali muqaam jannat mein

verses.saheeh: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
verses.khattab: whose fruit will hang within reach
verses.jalalayn: ﻿whose clusters, whose fruits, are in easy reach, nearby, reached [easily] by one who may be standing, or sitting or reclining.
verses.romanUrdu: Jiske phalon ke guchhey jhuke padh rahey hongey

verses.uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
verses.indopak: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْۤـــًٔا بِۢمَاۤ اَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى الْاَيَّامِ الْخَـالِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati
verses.saheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And so it will be said to them: ‘Eat and drink in enjoyment (hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, mutahanni’īna, ‘while you are enjoying [them]’) for what you did in advance in former days’, [in days] that have passed during the [life of the] world.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aise logon se kaha jayega) mazey se khao aur pio apne un aamal ke badle jo tumne guzre huey dino mein kiye hain

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِىَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِشِمَالِهٖ ۙ فَيَقُوْلُ يٰلَيْتَنِىْ لَمْ اُوْتَ كِتٰبِيَهْ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu bishim<u>a</u>lihi fayaqoolu y<u>a</u> laytanee lam oota kit<u>a</u>biyah
verses.saheeh: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
verses.khattab: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, ‘O (yā is for calling attention [to something]) would that I had not been given my book,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jiska naam-e-aamal uske bayein (left) haath mein diya jayega woh kahega “ kaash mera aamal nama mujhey na diya gaya hota

verses.saheeh: And had not known what is my account.
verses.khattab: nor known anything of my reckoning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and not known what my account were!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur main na jaanta ke mera hisaab kya hai

verses.saheeh: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
verses.khattab: I wish death was the end
verses.jalalayn: ﻿O would that it, namely, death in [the life of] this world, had been the [final] end, that had terminated my life, so that I am not resurrected.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaash meri wahi maut (jo duniya mei aayi thi) faisla-kun hoti

verses.saheeh: My wealth has not availed me.
verses.khattab: My wealth has not benefited me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My wealth has not availed me.
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj mera maal mere kuch kaam na aaya

verses.saheeh: Gone from me is my authority."
verses.khattab: My authority has been stripped from me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿My authority, my strength, my argument, has gone from me’ (the [final] hā’ in kitābiyah, ‘my book’, hisābiyah, ‘my account’, and sultāniyah, ‘my authority’, is for [consonantal] quiescence; and it is retained [when reciting] with a pause as well as without a pause, in accordance with the authoritative [version of the] Qur'anic text and the transmitted reports; some elide it when reciting without a pause).
verses.romanUrdu: Mera sara iqtedaar khatam ho gaya

verses.saheeh: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Seize him — addressing the keepers of Hell — then fetter him, bind his hands to his necks in fetters,
verses.romanUrdu: (hukum hoga) pakdo isey aur iski gardan mei touk daal do

verses.saheeh: Then into Hellfire drive him.
verses.khattab: then burn them in Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then admit him into Hell-fire, into the scorching Fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir isey jahannum mein jhoonk do

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةٖ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعٗا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ فِىْ سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُوْنَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوْهُ ۗ
verses.saheeh: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
verses.khattab: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then in a chain whose length is seventy cubits — [each cubit being] that of an angel’s forearm — insert him, after admitting him into the Fire (the fā’ [of fa’slukūhu] does not prevent the verb from being semantically connected to the preceding adverbial clause).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir isko satter(seventy) haath lambi zanjeer mei jakad do

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: innahu kana la yuminu biallahi al'atheemi
verses.saheeh: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
verses.khattab: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! he never believed in God the Tremendous,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh na Allah buzurg-o-bartar par iman lata tha

verses.saheeh: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.khattab: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and never urged the feeding of the needy;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na miskeen ko khana khilane ki targeeb deta tha

verses.saheeh: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
verses.khattab: So this Day they will have no close friend here
verses.jalalayn: ﻿therefore here today he has no [loyal] friend, [no] relative to avail him,
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza aaj na yahan iska koi yaar-e-gamkhaar hai

verses.saheeh: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
verses.khattab: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus
verses.jalalayn: ﻿nor any food except pus, the vile excretions of the inhabitants of the Fire — or it [ghislīn] may denote certain trees therein —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na zakhmon ke dhowan (washing of wounds) ke siwa iske liye koi khana

verses.saheeh: None will eat it except the sinners.
verses.khattab: which none will eat except the evildoers.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿which none shall eat but the sinners’, the disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Jisey khatakaaron (sinners) ke siwa koi nahin khata

verses.saheeh: So I swear by what you see
verses.khattab: Now, I do swear by whatever you see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So indeed (fa-lā: lā is extra) I swear by all that you see, of creatures,
verses.romanUrdu: Pas nahin, main qasam khata hoon un cheezon ki bhi jo tum dekhte ho

verses.saheeh: And what you do not see
verses.khattab: and whatever you cannot see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and all that you do not see: of them, in other words, [I swear] by all creatures:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unki bhi jinhein tum nahin dekhte

verses.saheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
verses.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger
verses.jalalayn: ﻿it, that is to say, the Qur'an, is indeed the speech of a noble messenger, in other words, he has spoken it as a message from God, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek Rasool-e-kareem ka qaul ( speech ) hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٖ ۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَّمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wama huwa biqawli sha'irin qaleelan ma tuminoona
verses.saheeh: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
verses.khattab: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it is not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!
verses.romanUrdu: Kisi shayar ka qaul nahin hai, tumlog kam hi iman latey ho

verses.uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٖ ۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona
verses.saheeh: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
verses.khattab: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nor [is it] the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you remember! (read both verbs either in the second person plural or in the third person plural; the mā [preceding both verbs] is extra, intended for emphasis). The meaning is: they believed and remembered only very few things of what the Prophet (s) did, [things] such as [his] good acts, [his] kindness to kin and abstinence; yet this will be of no avail to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na yeh kisi kaahin(soothsayer) ka qaul hai , tum log kam hi gaur karte ho

verses.saheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Rather, it is, a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh Rabb-ul alameen ki taraf se nazil huwa hai

verses.saheeh: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
verses.khattab: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And had he, namely, the Prophet (s), fabricated any lies against Us, by communicating from Us that which We have not said,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur agar is (Nabi) ne khud ghad kar koi baat hamari taraf mansook ki hoti

verses.saheeh: We would have seized him by the right hand;
verses.khattab: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We would have assuredly seized him, We would have exacted vengeance [against him], as punishment, by the Right Hand, by [Our] strength and power;
verses.romanUrdu: To hum iska dayan(right) haath padkad letay

verses.saheeh: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
verses.khattab: then severed his aorta
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then We would have assuredly severed his life-artery, the aorta of the heart, a vein that connects with it, and which if severed results in that person’s death,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur iski rag-e-gardan (life vein) kaat daalte

verses.uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
verses.indopak: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِيْنَ
verses.saheeh: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
verses.khattab: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and not one of you (ahadin is the subject of mā, min being extra, used to emphasise the negation; minkum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ahadin) could have defended him (hājizīna is the predicate of [the preceding] mā, and it is used in the plural because ahad, when employed in a negatory context, denotes a plural sense; the [suffixed] pronoun in ‘anhu refers to the Prophet), in other words, there is none to prevent Us from punishing him.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir tum mein se koi (humein)is kaam se rokne wala na hota

verses.saheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
verses.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And assuredly it, that is, the Qur'an, is a reminder for the God-fearing.
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat yeh parheizgar logon ke liye ek naseehat hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
verses.khattab: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And assuredly We know that some of you, O people, are deniers, of the Qur'an, and [some of you are] believers [in it].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum jante hain ke tum mein se kuch log jhutlane waley hain

verses.saheeh: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
verses.khattab: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And assuredly it, that is, the Qur'an, is a [cause of] anguish for the disbelievers, when they see the reward of those who affirmed its truth and the punishment of those who denied it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aise kafiron ke liye yaqeenan yeh mujeeb-e-hasrat (cause of regret) hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
verses.khattab: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And assuredly it, that is, the Qur'an, is the certain truth.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh bilkul yaqeeni haqq hai

verses.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So glorify, exalt as transcendent, the Name (bi’smi: the bā’ [bi-] is extra) of your Lord, the Tremendous: glory be to Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey nabi, apne Rubb-e-azeem ke naam ki tasbeeh karo
